import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Load the datasets
invasion_success = pd.read_csv('/data/invasion_success_pathways.csv')

# Display the first few rows of the invasion_success dataset
invasion_success.head()

# Check for missing values
invasion_success.isnull().sum()

# Check the distribution of introduction pathways
invasion_success['intro.pathway'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of minimum residence time (mrt)
sns.histplot(invasion_success['mrt'], kde=True)
plt.title('Distribution of Minimum Residence Time (mrt)')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between introduction pathway and success metrics
sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Introduction Pathway and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Introduction Pathway and Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.show()

sns.boxplot(x='intro.pathway', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Introduction Pathway and Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Introduction Pathway')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Check the relationship between minimum residence time and success metrics
sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='number.of.invaded.plots', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time and Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Number of Invaded Plots')
plt.show()

sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='area.of.occupancy.10km', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time and Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Area of Occupancy (10km scale)')
plt.show()

sns.scatterplot(x='mrt', y='invaded.niche.breadth', data=invasion_success)
plt.title('Relationship between Minimum Residence Time and Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.xlabel('Minimum Residence Time (years)')
plt.ylabel('Invaded Niche Breadth')
plt.show()

# Perform linear regression to analyze the relationship between introduction pathway and success metrics
# Convert 'intro.pathway' to a categorical variable
invasion_success['intro.pathway'] = pd.Categorical(invasion_success['intro.pathway'])

# Create dummy variables for 'intro.pathway'
dummy_pathways = pd.get_dummies(invasion_success['intro.pathway'], drop_first=True)

# Add dummy variables to the dataset
invasion_success = pd.concat([invasion_success, dummy_pathways], axis=1)

# Define the response variable and predictor variables
X = invasion_success[['intro.pathway_Gardening', 'intro.pathway_Unintentional', 'mrt']]
y = invasion_success['number.of.invaded.plots']

# Add a constant to the predictor variables
X = sm.add_constant(X)

# Fit the linear regression model
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()

# Print the summary of the model
model.summary()

# Repeat the analysis for 'area.of.occupancy.10km' and 'invaded.niche.breadth'
y = invasion_success['area.of.occupancy.10km']
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
model.summary()

y = invasion_success['invaded.niche.breadth']
model = sm.OLS(y, X).fit()
model.summary()
